title: llm-usage-metrics summary report output (v1)
description: Envelope and payload for summary report --json output. Diagnostics are excluded by contract.

data.description: Summary payload: today, the last 7 days, month to date, and daily activity over the past year.

timezone.description: IANA timezone or offset the periods are computed in.

periods.description: Periods in fixed order: today, last7Days, monthToDate.

monthEnd.description: Month-to-date run rate and the configured budget. Optional so v1 reports from earlier releases stay valid.

monthToDateCacheSavingsUsd.description: Estimated month-to-date savings from cache reads: cache-read tokens priced at the input rate minus the cache-read rate. Absent when no cache reads could be priced.

activity.description: Daily activity and streaks. Always emitted by current releases; optional so v1 reports from earlier releases stay valid.

activeDays.description: Days with at least one event in the period.

sourceTotals.description: Usage totals for one source within a period (non-negative).

activeDays.description: Days with at least one event in the period.

sources.description: Sources with usage in the period, by cost then tokens then id.

activity.description: Daily activity over the past 53 ISO weeks: from the Monday 52 weeks before the current week, to today.

from.description: First day of the activity window, always a Monday (YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: Last day of the activity window: today (YYYY-MM-DD).

activeDays.description: Days with at least one event in the window.

currentStreak.description: Consecutive active days ending today, or ending yesterday while today has no usage yet.

longestStreak.description: Longest run of consecutive active days in the window.

bestDay.description: Day with the most tokens; ties go to the earliest date. Absent without usage.

costUsd.description: Cost of the day; absent when no event had a known price.

costIncomplete.description: True when some events of the day had no known price.

days.description: Every day of the window in date order, with its intensity level: 0 without usage, 1-4 by quartile of active-day tokens.

daysElapsed.description: Days of the month so far, today included.

projectedCostUsd.description: Month-to-date cost scaled to the whole month. Absent before the third day of the month or without a known cost.

costIncomplete.description: True when the month-to-date cost leaves out events without a known price.
